title: ComfyUI 6DOF Camera — 3D Scene Manipulation & Character Staging
summary: A ComfyUI extension for 6 Degrees of Freedom camera movement and character placement within 3D-reconstructed scenes. It enables precise view synthesis and character insertion by combining depth-aware reprojection with interactive Three.js-based staging.
research_notes: Includes specialized support for 360° equirectangular panoramas and 'Stamping' nodes to preserve environment consistency during iterative inpainting.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from basic projection nodes into a complete 3D scene-editing suite. Significant updates introduced an interactive Three.js viewer, a poseable IK mannequin (Character Placer) for ControlNet-ready skeletons, and integration with video models like Wan2.1 for camera path animation.
